scope: Source-backed adjudication with three focused overlay race20 commands; no shared production/source mutation, native/GUI execution, native settlement qualification or whole-suite rerun. Held settlement callback is explicitly invoked in owner control only.

findings.reason: PrepareEdit validates current source/draft and returns a copied proposal using the already-existing draft token; it does not register an outstanding exclusive request or mutate Grid. There is no edit-request cleanup API because there is no registered prepared request. Cancel work preserves the draft and lets task worker/delivery cleanup refund credits.

source_facts.detail: Validation and returned token/state/stamp only; no Grid assignment.
Prepare before tasks.Start; source pointer only after CompleteEdit.

findings.observations: Repeated Prepare returns identical proposals without Grid.State change. Cancelled admitted edit retains worker credit until explicit worker and owner terminals, preserves source and exact draft, then Save accepts. Refused executor Submit starts no job, refunds all credits and leaves draft preparable; same-draft Save retry succeeds. Both run owner batches1/7/64.

findings.reason: Editable is the user editing capability, not an immutable domain update prohibition. edited is the bounded worker domain candidate constructor intentionally shared by user saves and explicit External +1. User Begin checks Editable before any worker admission; Prepare/Complete also check read-only. External domain updates can change column0 while it remains user read-only. Rejecting column0 in shared edited would disable the declared external-update workflow.

source_facts.detail: EditCell exposes Editable only for columns other than0.
Begin refuses read-only before creating draft.
Explicit external update captures active identity/version, creates immutable worker candidate, then replaces accepted source before domain pointer.

findings.observations: Column0 Begin returns ErrGridEditReadOnly; Prepare/Save have no draft, Grid.State/source/executor ledger unchanged, and no task/array copy occurs. Explicit External +1 then succeeds through worker and owner terminals, increments domain/cell version, uses fresh array backing, preserves old immutable value and keeps Editable=false; user Begin still refuses afterward.
